entries.competence: Demonstrate ability to relate man’s development to the environment and technology.
entries.objective: To relate man’s development to the environment and technology.
entries.main_topic: 3. DEVELOPMENT OF ECONOMIC ACTIVITIES AND THEIR IMPACT
entries.teaching_act: To guide the students through questions and answers to give the correct meaning and show relationships between agriculture environment, technology and development. To guide the students individually to conduct library research on how agriculture changed man’s life. To guide the groups to present their finding in class for discussion and clarification and write brief notes for presentation in class.

The groups to present their finding in class for discussion and clarification and write brief notes for presentation in class.

entries.assessment: Are students able to explain the development of agriculture in pre-colonial Africa.
